note: Feature flags for HUD code that is written but not part of the base game. hiding: Orb removed hiding from the base game and holds it for a future stealth-specialist fighter (docs/ep/vision.md). With it off the HUD ignores the hidden state and the lost-trail cue everywhere (plate chips, the eye-slash marker, the strip's ping and last-seen mark, the silhouette's fading); the code stays for that fighter. Turn it on in a fighter's data when that fighter exists. touch_full and remap: the Settings screen lists the Full touch layout and the Remap controls entry, dimmed and marked Soon, until Controls' touch-full layout and the remap screen exist; both are on now. touch_full and remap: the Settings screen lists the Full touch layout and the Remap controls entry, dimmed and marked Soon, until Controls' touch-full layout and the remap screen exist; both are on now.
